captionScore: maximum cosine across each label's fixed name/alias/description captions
pooling: tokenizer encode without special tokens or padding; float32 token lookup mean; L2 normalize only for cosine; 128 uses first dimensions
baseline: same fixed captions, Unicode NFKC lowercase 1-3 character TF-IDF cosine retrieval; not the existing trained tiny student
selection: per variant/registry and guard mode maximize correct positives - 5*wrong-positive - 5*negative-accept; ties choose fewer mistakes then more correct then larger thresholds
guardMode: authored broad negation veto; reject multiple distinct explicit labels, conjunctions and compositional relations; otherwise retrieval thresholds. Alias detections constrain scope only and never supply prediction. One object/category only, no order/relation inference
guardNegation: ない|ません|不要|使わず|除い|やめ|ではなく|じゃなく or standalone English not/without/dont/never/no
guardComposition: multiple explicit labels or standalone Japanese と/および/そして, English and/plus/with; relative composition 上に/下に/先に/端に/貫く/through/above/below
metrics: positive accepted coverage, accepted exact precision, exact correct/all positives, near family/all positives; negative false positive with unknown/negation/scope separate
heldoutPolicy: freeze captions, method, thresholds and selected candidate hashes before seeing fresh independent evaluator inputs; existing tiny heldout excluded
pilotChanges: Calibration-only pilot found alias-first wrongly interpreted incidental named nouns in descriptive positives; remove alias override. Dot warnings with finite6e-8 agreement replaced by explicit float32 multiply/sum. No independent input read.
